plan.title: Conversion Summary Vendors and RFQ Return

steps.note: Start an eRFX project that will be converted from RFQ to Auction.
Create the RFQ stage required for conversion.
Apply an RFQ template before adding line items.
Add a product so vendors can submit quotes.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite two vendors to provide several quoting vendors.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can quote.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Submit a quote from the first invited vendor.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit a quote from a second invited vendor.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Establish that two vendor responses exist before conversion.
Reach the Auction Setup screen produced by RFQ conversion.
Confirm conversion reached the setup screen without an application error.
